description: Draft of a legal document in Hebrew. Dated Ṭevet 5359 AM = December 1598 / January 1599 CE. Involves Yaʿaqov ha-Levi and [...] b. Natan ha-Kohen and a certain appointee named Yehuda (the scribe originally wrote המורשה הנז in both places and then specified Yehuda). Mentions a sum (7000 or 9000?) of medins. Mentions a שילבש (= Çelebi?) and an amīr and maybe al-Buḥayra.
description_he: מסמך משפטי בעברית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
